propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no live reader after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its classify_probe_response consumer
The keys were operationally live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 and are documented as user-configurable, making hard removal a genuine upgrade hazard without operator sign-off
Both keys must be registered as scheduled deprecations (remove_in v1.0.0) that emit warnings when present, while remaining accepted and validated unchanged
Write-only data center transport plumbing (resolved_statuses param, _resolved_statuses attribute, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant) must be removed as behaviour-neutral cleanup
Config schema fields must carry read-via markers naming the follow-up hard-removal ticket, and documentation must describe both keys as deprecated and inert
